Mire Ooze (CV 11)

A creeping mass of mud-colored digestive slime, with partly dissolved scraps suspended inside. It has no eyes or clear front, sensing contact and nearby ground vibration instead.

Attributes: Brawn +1; Fortitude +2; Agility -2; Guile -2; Knowledge -2; Reason -1

HP: 16 · Speed: 3 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 1

Evasion: 1 Boon · Threat: None · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (1)\ Immunities: Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep; Blinded

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Clinging sludge

A hooked limb braces against the bank and heaves its catch toward the dark water.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Brawn. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Pull 2. Standard defense: Pull 1.

Clinging Recoil

The striking hand comes away trailing a thick strand that resists every hurried step.

After an adjacent attacker’s attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, apply Slowed 2 to that attacker. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. This grants no grapple, extra damage or equipment destruction.

Shed the Grasp

The surface peels away, leaving a useless handful while the body gathers again.

Choose one holder and reduce that holder’s Grappled contribution by 1, also reducing this creature’s total Grappled rating by 1. End that hold if its contribution reaches 0. It must have a Maneuver available; cannot use this while Grappled 3. No damage or free movement.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Touch; detects ground vibration within 3 squares only on the same connected surface.

Signs: Metal objects remain where everything organic has gone.

Purpose: Dissolve edible material.

Tactics and retreat: Pull prey closer with a sticky limb; give up pursuit beyond the wet ground.

Counterplay and conversation: Keep distance and cross dry elevated stone.

Habitat: Marsh; sewer · Communication: None

Loot: Indigestible coins: 8 coins in an established feeding hollow, not every ooze.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: A slow or broad exposed body gives the attacker a Boon. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

Reference damage: 2/3/4

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.3

Action review (#1279): U 1.15 → 1.3: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=4.596, O=2.000. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
